# Flex Direction

::: info 实现进度 55% · 进行中
Playground 已 `@source` 文档 markdown，这些类名可在本页示例里跑。未写入 `helpers.css`；SDK 里 schema 动态 class 仍依赖源码扫描。`m:` / `pc:` 只接到间距和宽高。
:::

父节点先写 `flex`，再用方向类。复杂布局也可以直接用 `type: flex`。

```schema
type: page
body:
  - type: container
    bodyClassName: flex flex-col gap-2
    body:
      - type: tpl
        className: bg-muted p-sm rounded-md
        tpl: 上
      - type: tpl
        className: bg-muted p-sm rounded-md
        tpl: 下
  - type: container
    className: m-t-sm
    bodyClassName: flex flex-row-reverse gap-2
    body:
      - type: tpl
        className: bg-muted p-sm rounded-md
        tpl: 甲
      - type: tpl
        className: bg-muted p-sm rounded-md
        tpl: 乙
```

## 类名

| Class | Properties |
| --- | --- |
| `flex-row` | `flex-direction: row` |
| `flex-row-reverse` | `flex-direction: row-reverse` |
| `flex-col` | `flex-direction: column` |
| `flex-col-reverse` | `flex-direction: column-reverse` |

响应式：`m:` / `pc:` 目前只接到间距和宽高辅助类。其它类请用 Tailwind 断点（`max-md:` / `md:`）。状态前缀见 [辅助类-状态样式](/style/state)。
